description: Source code for handling X.509 v3 certificate extensions related to CRL distribution points, issuing distribution points, and related structures in OpenSSL/boringssl.

classes.name: DIST_POINT_NAME
classes.description: Represents a distribution point name, either full name or relative name.

classes.name: DIST_POINT
classes.description: Represents a distribution point with optional reasons and CRL issuer.

classes.name: ISSUING_DIST_POINT
classes.description: Represents an issuing distribution point with various optional flags and distribution point.

methods.name: gnames_from_sectname
methods.description: Extracts general names from a section name or list.

methods.name: set_dist_point_name
methods.description: Decodes a DistributionPointName from configuration and sets it.

methods.name: set_reasons
methods.description: Sets reason flags from a list of reason names.

methods.name: print_reasons
methods.description: Prints reason flags to a BIO output.

methods.name: crldp_from_section
methods.description: Creates a DIST_POINT from a configuration section.

methods.name: v2i_crld
methods.description: Converts configuration values to a stack of DIST_POINT structures.

methods.name: dpn_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling DIST_POINT_NAME ASN1 operations.

methods.name: i2r_idp
methods.description: Converts an ISSUING_DIST_POINT to a human-readable form.

methods.name: v2i_idp
methods.description: Converts configuration values to an ISSUING_DIST_POINT structure.

methods.name: print_gens
methods.description: Prints general names to a BIO output.

methods.name: print_distpoint
methods.description: Prints a DIST_POINT_NAME to a BIO output.

methods.name: i2r_crldp
methods.description: Converts a stack of DIST_POINT to a human-readable form.

methods.name: DIST_POINT_set_dpname
methods.description: Sets the name of a DIST_POINT_NAME to a given X509_NAME.
